verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented capability for users to define event-triggered rules that run actions automatically in Oneleet. What it does show is adjacent: fixed daily repository scans, a built-in CI check on pull requests, Fieldwork evidence collection 'on your schedule', and status-page incident emails. These are recurring schedules, built-in behaviors, or notifications, not user-defined event→action rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
